full_text_pass_2026_10_03.note: Of the 39 S-class entries (28 distinct works) that had no Semantic Scholar citing sentence, 22 entries (16 works) were read in the citing papers' full texts in the browser on 2026-10-03 (MDPI HTML pages; Springer, arXiv, Copernicus, Wiley and other PDFs via pdf.js), the reference-list entry located and the sentences citing it extracted. 17 entries (12 works) were not reachable: Elsevier pages refused the browser (Gondwana Research 2025, Geoscience Frontiers 2023, New Techno Humanities 2023, JASTP 2024), Wiley's AJES 2024 and two Springer German book chapters are paywalled, MIT DSpace and Authorea sit behind verification pages, and the Mises Institute, SSRN and EarthArXiv files could not be downloaded.
